interface.longDescription:
MyMentorSteve provides practical business education grounded in Steve Simonson's Catalyst88 training, Founder Foundations, and Awesomers podcast materials. Published by Catalyst88, LLC.

Work through product sourcing, supplier decisions, global trade, manufacturing, distribution, ecommerce growth, delegation, organization design, leadership, and operating systems. Get focused questions, relevant source references, and concrete next steps in a direct style with real-world examples, metaphors, and occasional sarcasm.

This is an AI mentor informed by Steve's published teachings, not a live conversation with Steve. It provides advice and relevant informational links; it does not connect to business accounts, contact suppliers, book appointments, process purchases, or take actions on your behalf. It can respond in your preferred language.

Business education is not individualized investment, legal, tax, or medical advice. Historical documents and examples are identified as such, and business outcomes are not guaranteed. Learn more at MyMentorSteve.com and Catalyst88.com.
